verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents running operations over many items at once in its own workflows. You can run thousands of evaluations without writing retry or concurrency logic, group traces into datasets and rerun them through different app versions, and have evaluators score experiment results automatically across a dataset. However, there is no evidence of general bulk-action tooling such as multi-select edit, delete, annotate, tag or export across traces, spans or prompts. Missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/annotate operations in the UI or API, batch CLI/API endpoints for arbitrary items, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
